title: Grateful Dead Live at Seminole Indian Village on 1969-05-23
source: Master Soundboard Reels > 1st generation reels > 2nd generation reels > PCM (Sony HG beta tape)

ai_review.summary: Excellent soundboard capture of the legendary May 23 1969 Florida show, highlighted by a soaring Dark Star that rolls into St. Stephen.
ai_review.review: Both reviewers rave about this famous two‑night run, praising the ferocious energy and especially the Dark Star that “coils, snarls, pops, and flexes” before seguing into St. Stephen. The SBD source is described as clean enough for high‑fidelity streaming, with no noted flaws, making it a must‑listen for any Deadhead.

ai_rating.rationale: Two detailed 5‑star reviews consistently praise both the performance (high energy, standout Dark Star) and the soundboard recording quality, leaving little doubt of an exceptional show.

recording_quality.technical_notes: No complaints; reviewers consider it a clean board suitable for high‑fidelity streaming.

show_quality.setlist_flow: A classic late‑60s sequence with the Dark Star leading into St. Stephen; overall a high‑energy, slightly raucous but beloved performance.
